expect_red: every box wears its body's ink and every connector its weight from the first paint, before any hover (ISSUE_20261120_a_map_box_wears_its_bodys_colour_only_after_the_pointer_has_passed_over_it)

mutations.contract: A map element wears its base class -- a box its body's tint, a connector its between-bodies weight -- before anything paints it.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_lug_stacks_line_up_and_each_link_is_a_row_on_the_map (2026-11-22). Without the write at register time the class reaches the element only on the first hover, which is the defect the issue measured.
